name: capacitor-offline-first
description: Designs and implements offline-first data in Capacitor apps - local SQLite source of truth with @capgo/capacitor-fast-sql (`FastSQL.connect`, `KeyValueStore`), an outbox/sync queue, delta pulls, conflict resolution, @capacitor/network `networkStatusChange`, background sync with @capgo/capacitor-background-task, and why localStorage/IndexedDB get evicted and service workers break plugin injection in native WebViews. Use when the app must work without internet, data disappears after iOS storage pr
author: Cap-go
